asks: How long since you slept properly?
Do you want the blanket unfolded?
description: A shelf cut straight out of the rock at the height of a bed, with a single folded blanket squared off at one end. It is exactly long enough for a person and it has been swept.
emotes: {it} sits there being exactly the right length.
{it} catches the light along the worn dish of it.
looks: The stone is worn into a shallow dish along its length, and the dish fits a body.
The blanket is coarse and clean and folded with real care.
There is a small ledge cut at the head end, for whatever you are carrying.
name: a stone shelf laid with a blanket
says: Lie down. It is what it is cut for.
It is not as cold as it looks.
Everyone who has used this got up again.
